beliefs: f strips all leading and trailing spaces from the input [E2, E8, E16, E21, E23]
After space stripping, f strips the first character iff it is 'H' and the remaining string has length >= 2, regardless of the second character [E6, E11, E21, E22, E23]
The H-strip applies to 'H' followed by lowercase, digit, space, symbol, or uppercase [E6, E11, E22]
Single 'H' alone (after space strip) returns empty string [E21, E22]
Strings starting with any other uppercase letter (A,B,C,D,E,F,G,I,J,K,L,M,N,O,P,Q,R,S,T,U,V,W,X,Y,Z) are returned unchanged after space strip [E10, E14, E15, E17, E18, E19, E20]
Strings starting with lowercase or digit are returned unchanged after space strip [E2, E8, E19]
Empty strings and all-space strings return empty after space strip [E1, E8, E21, E23]
notes: E23 shows leading spaces are also stripped (not just trailing), so I changed rstrip to strip. This also fixes E2's ' A'->'A'. The H-strip rule after space stripping is unchanged.
